observations: Three photos show a black, ribbed plastic storage tank stacked among other similar tanks.
The tank has a white logo and text 'GEEPEE' on its surface, visible in all three photos.
The tank appears used, with visible dirt, dust, and minor surface wear.
A small circular opening is visible near the bottom, likely a drain or outlet.
The tank is cylindrical with horizontal corrugations for structural reinforcement.
No capacity markings (e.g., 1000L) are visible on the tank in any photo.
The tank is not shown in a full context, such as its full height or whether it is upright or lying down.
No lid is visible in any photo, though the seller claims it is included.

claims.claim: 1000l Geepee brand vertical plastic storage tank
claims.evidence: The brand 'Geepee' is visible in all photos, but the capacity '1000l' is not visible on the tank. No capacity marking is shown in any photo.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may not be 1000L as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the tank's capacity marking, typically on the side or base, or a label indicating 1000L.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller capacity tank, likely 500L or 800L, which would reduce its value.

risks.risk: The tank may have structural damage or cracks not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tank's surface, especially around the drain opening and base, to check for cracks or warping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, which would reduce its value.

risks.risk: The tank may not be food-grade as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing any certification label or material specification indicating food-grade plastic.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-food-grade, which would reduce its value for intended use.

risks.risk: The tank may be missing parts, such as the lid or base.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full tank from all angles, including the top and bottom, to confirm completeness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete, which would reduce its value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the tank's side or base showing the capacity marking (e.g., 1000L).
A close-up photo of the tank's surface to check for cracks or damage.
A photo showing the lid and base to confirm completeness.
A photo of any certification or material label indicating food-grade plastic.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
